original.target_description: Study 1 hedonic regressions of log listing price in Stockholm, Table 1. Exact regression specification unresolved from supplied locator.

notes: Identity assessment: the ResearchGate wrapper identifies a 2015 SSRN item (10.2139/ssrn.2624181), but the embedded author-uploaded article identifies Eyal Ert, Aliza Fleischer and Nathan Magen, the matching title, Tourism Management 55 (2016) 62–73, and DOI 10.1016/j.tourman.2016.01.013 (canonical L66–L75, L197–L205). This embedded article is primary-report text. The frozen web parse preserves retrieval gaps and is not a complete PDF; assessment is restricted to the available Study 1 results and Table 1. No PDF was supplied. Unassigned sides and fields are placeholders only. The Study 1/Table 1 locator identifies the price analysis but not which of three visual-based-trust specifications is intended. Printed coefficient candidates are 0.0690 (SE 0.030), 0.0765 (SE 0.032), and 0.284 (SE 0.124); each is marked ** (p<0.05). A common significance bound does not resolve the intended same-test coefficient/p pair. The interaction specification differs from the additive specifications. Guests’ choice belongs to Study 2, not this table. No candidate was selected; no standardisation or effect conversion was inferred. Candidate evidence: Visual-based trust 0.0690 ... ** ...
